primitives.name: Data Integrity Check
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Status:** integrity and schema checks pass for the complete ZIP currently used by this project.
primitives.assumptions: The ZIP archive is consistent with expected internal structure and checksums.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if any schema or integrity check fails.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's probabilistic data validation kernel where schema compliance implies posterior likelihood of data correctness.
layer2.telemetry: ZIP CRC and schema validation results

primitives.name: Player Row Count Verification
primitives.verbatim_quote: The source audit found 463,189 Combine tracking rows, of which 431,094 are player rows; these resolve to 6,310 unique player/drill/attempt keys.
primitives.assumptions: Each player/drill/attempt combination uniquely identifies a tracking event.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if duplicate or missing keys are detected.

layer2.mapping: Derives player-level granularity for GSE's state transition logic and GSI's feature engineering pipeline.
layer2.telemetry: Unique key count and row resolution metrics

primitives.name: Temporal Consistency Assurance
primitives.verbatim_quote: An independent timestamp check using the full attempt key found no duplicate or non-increasing times; the 424,784 within-attempt intervals are all within 5 ms of the expected 0.1-second cadence.
primitives.assumptions: Timestamps are monotonically increasing and sampled at regular intervals.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if timestamps are inconsistent or exceed tolerance.

layer2.mapping: Ensures temporal alignment for GSE's event-driven reasoning and GSI's time-series feature extraction.
